input_origin: Current private Google Drive files, grounded by live metadata before each download

gzip.method: Stream current CSV into gzip level 9, filename predictions.csv, mtime 0, with the historical TextIOWrapper final sync-flush behavior

report.stdout: Verified 876300 predictions; exported all 1905 sensitivity cells

comparison_policy: Exact file size and SHA256 for both generated report products; semantic JSON equality for report COMMIT. No numeric tolerance or relabeling.
checks: Pinned COMMIT, per-model summary, metadata, and gzip SHA256 and size checks
3175 complete unique recording-ID sets, each containing exactly the 276 eligible recordings
Every predicted_ai value matches the raw_score >= 0.5 decision
Model SHA256 values match per-model summaries
All population row counts, true-positive and false-negative counts, and sensitivities reconcile
All 1905 aggregate cells contain five distinct fold models
Single-class balanced accuracy, specificity and ROC-AUC remain unavailable
scientific_boundary: This is an exact replay of persisted predictions into AI-only Native60 sensitivity reports. It is not a new model fit, audio feature extraction, or independent regeneration of raw scores. It does not measure balanced accuracy or generalize the eight-audio sample validation.
instructions: Run validation/native60_replay/run_replay.sh from the code repository with two new directories and MUSIC_DETECTOR_DRIVE_TOKEN in the environment. Temporary report inputs should remain outside version control.
